ITEM 1 | Finely chopped curly kale, dark green with ruffled, frilly leaf edges and a slightly matte, moist surface; forms a loose mound covering roughly 30% of the plate's left-center area, about 10 cm across and 3 cm tall, with small dry flecks scattered throughout | 90
ITEM 2 | Mixed baby salad greens (flat, pale-to-medium green leaves with pale stems), glossy and lightly dressed, loosely piled upper-right of the mound, about 9 cm across and 2 cm tall, with a few reddish-brown dried fruit or pepper pieces and small red chili flecks mixed in | 45
ITEM 3 | Roasted potato wedges, golden-brown with darker charred edges and a crisp, slightly dry surface; three to four chunky wedges about 3 to 4 cm long and 2 cm thick, lying along the lower-right edge of the greens | 110
ITEM 4 | Dark brown, slightly shriveled roasted piece (possibly a charred vegetable skin or mushroom-like fragment), glossy with blackened spots, about 3 cm across, sitting beside the potato wedges on the right edge | 12
ITEM 5 | Thin reddish-orange dressing or sauce smears and small droplets, faint sheen on the plate surface near the greens' right edge | 5
